title: Dry Run, practice drill for digital arrest scam calls
disclaimer: This is practice, not protection. It does not measure your risk or prevent fraud.

hero.headline: Practice before you get the call
hero.subheadline: A kind and realistic drill for digital arrest scam calls. Hear the intimidation in a safe space, then keep the one habit that helps.
hero.cta_invite: Send an invite to a family member

steps.title: Send a private link
steps.description: An organizer creates a private invite link for one family member.

steps.title: Take the drill call
steps.description: The participant takes a simulated call from a fictional officer of a fictional agency.

steps.title: Read the kind debrief
steps.description: The debrief shows where compliance happened and reinforces the safe habit to keep.

items.title: Hang up immediately
items.description: Real officers never hold court or threaten arrest over a video call.

items.title: Verify through official channels
items.description: Call the national cybercrime helpline 1930 or walk into a police station.

items.title: Talk to family
items.description: Scammers demand secrecy. Breaking the isolation immediately breaks the scam.

footer.notice: Dry Run is an educational practice drill. It does not certify safety or guarantee that fraud is prevented.
